entities.summary: Rasmus Paludan is a Danish-Swedish politician and lawyer, who is the founder and leader of the far-right, nationalist, Danish political party Stram Kurs. Paludan has become known for his extremist views, including that Islam should be banned and that immigrants of non-Western background should be deported from Denmark. He is considered by political scientists and media to be far-right and a right-wing extremist.
